fsHeroTitle: Start your own business, fully set up by O2O Boss
fsHeroBody: Like the big chains: the same brand, look and products in every outlet. We set up everything; you run it and earn.
fsIncludedTitle: What we set up for you
fsIncBrandBody: The O2O Boss name, logo and signage, done the same way everywhere.
fsIncInteriorBody: Shop design, furniture, lighting and fitting, ready to open.
fsIncProductsBody: A tested product range and your opening stock from our suppliers.
fsIncTrainingBody: How to run the outlet, serve customers and use the O2O Boss app.
fsIncLaunchBody: Opening-day promotion, and a team to call when you need help.
fsPackagesHelp: Costs are a starting guide. The final cost depends on the business and your city.
fsPkgKioskBody: A small counter in a market, mall or bus stand.
fsPkgStoreBody: A shop on a busy street, with more products.
fsPkgFlagshipBody: A big outlet with the full range and seating or service area.
fsPkgCustomBody: For several outlets or a larger space. We plan it with you.
fsCityLabel: City or town for the outlet
fsDoneBody: Our franchise team will call you within 2 to 3 working days to plan your outlet.
